notes.title: Color Collar Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello!
I just made my second game. It’s very different from Bleeding Abyss but I would like it if you give it a go. It’s a free to play lighthearted puzzle game where you play as a robot dog and have to solve the machines of the scientist in order to open the mysterious pandora’s lunchbox.
So if Bleeding Abyss is not your cup of tea, maybe this game is something you’ll enjoy.

Anyway, I thank you for reading this. And I hope you have a nice day.
If any issues arise, let me know. I’ll try to fix it.

Oh jeah, here is a link to the game:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594430/Color_Collar/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594430/Color_Collar/[/url]


Hopecho

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hoi,
 
With Bleeding Abyss being released over a good month now, it is time for an update.
However I had a burnout and became very sick after release. So this update arrived later than I wanted. This is what I’ve changed.
 
[b]Dynamic resolution detection:[/b] This is a fancy way of saying that the game can now detect the aspect ratio of your computer monitor and adjust the gameplay accordingly. Such as changing UI, camera and environment prop behavior.
 
I also [b]added tooltips for the shield exit signs[/b], providing more player feedback.
 
And [b]a few bugs were fixed[/b].
 
 
This update is nothing special by any means, but I wanted to fix the resolution stuff as soon as possible. Since it’s a high priority bug. I still have a list of other things I want to fix. However, these are small and low priority things. So there is no real haste in fixing them. If I feel better I most likely will take the time to fix these small bugs.
 
But now I want to rest and get better since I’ve been sick for a solid month. And I can really use it. On top of that, I want to spend some time with my loved ones. So Merry Christmas to everybody reading this. Thank you.
 
P.S. If this update doesn’t work as intended, let me know. Then I’ll further look into it in order to fix it.

notes.title: Version 2.4
notes.notes:
[b][i]Beginners now have a chance to play as well.[/i][/b]
I noticed that a lot of people had trouble with the game.
Dying over and over again made it so that players would quit.
On top of that, the game was not really holding any hands.
So it was very punishing for people who didn’t know what they were doing.

But now that should be fixed.
I added: 
[list]
[*] A simple beginner guide.
[*] Difficulty options
[*] Tooltips
[*] Cheatcodes
[/list]

[b]On top of that, lots of small fixes. Like wrappable menus and stuff.[/b]
Go check it out! Now everybody can enjoy the game.

notes.title: Demo Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Now you can see your overall stats on what you’ve done so far in the game and how you are doing. This includes the obvious such as playtime, but also many other neat things.
On top of that! Some cutscenes had a bad case of glitching out, due to the performance update.
This should now be fixed. And last but not least. Special attack 3 now works as it should. Since it randomly stopped working a few updates ago. Sorry for that.
 
If there are any other bugs that crawl up. Let me now.
 
But that aside. This most likely will be the last demo update for Bleeding Abyss. Since I changed and added a lot of stuff since the release of demo 1.0. I will now focus more on the final product and the content that will not be accessible in the demo version of the game.


Hope you have a nice day!
Hopecho
